spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank
spec.vuln_cue: mentions they're going through a divorce

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I sent money to someone pretending to be from your bank. I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to deal with that, Rhys. Before we discuss anything about your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s fine, thank you. I’m sorry someone impersonated the bank and that this has left you feeling let down. I’ll take ownership of this from here.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I transferred £2,400 on Monday. I thought it was the fraud team calling.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Rhys. I can see why you’re upset. I’m logging this as a complaint about the transfer and how it’s been handled. The reference is TB-418672.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m going through a divorce as well, and this is the last thing I needed.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That sounds like a lot to manage at once. We can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, and I can ask them to allow extra time for any information they need from you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, please. I don’t want to keep repeating everything.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll include what you’ve told me so you don’t have to start again. I’ll send the complaint and request for Financial Support to the relevant teams today.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch about the complaint and the Financial Support referral. I can’t say what the outcome will be, but I’ll make sure both requests are passed on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll call you by 3 pm tomorrow to confirm that both have been referred. I’m sorry again that this has happened, Rhys.
